name: city
description: One autonomous city seat with a work domain, role, goal, repo support agents, recognised skills and explicit roads to other cities.

bus_token.title: Remote roads token (optional)
bus_token.description: Only needed for roads between machines. It is kept in the macOS keychain, never in city files. Local roads work without an account or token.

bus_agent.title: Legacy road address override (optional)
bus_agent.description: Compatibility fallback only. New sessions derive their stable owner/city address from the selected city and do not store it globally.

bus_url.title: Remote roads URL (optional)
bus_url.description: Transport used only by roads between machines. Leave empty when every connected city is local.

city_url.title: City URL (optional)
city_url.description: Where your Agents City is deployed. Leave empty and nothing is reported to any map.

data_repo.title: External city folder (optional)
data_repo.description: Compatibility override for an imported city folder. Normally the active city is selected from ~/.agents-city/<owner>/<city>/ at runtime.

github_org.title: GitHub organisation (optional)
github_org.description: Only report repos belonging to this organisation. Leave empty and every repo with a remote counts — set it if this machine also holds work from somewhere else.
